findings.message: uses string concatenation or char-code construction to hide keywords
findings.remediation: Use readable, explicit code patterns; avoid character-code obfuscation.
findings.impact: Character-code construction hides string literals from grep-based detection.
findings.attack_vector: String.fromCharCode() builds dangerous strings at runtime — evades static patterns.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: passes an unvalidated dynamic destination to a network API
findings.remediation: Parse the destination, require HTTPS, and allowlist hosts and resolved IP ranges before making the request.
findings.impact: An attacker-controlled URL can make the plugin request internal services, cloud metadata, or attacker-selected hosts.
findings.attack_vector: A non-literal destination derived from request input reaches a network API without an evident allowlist guard.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: passes a plaintext HTTP destination to a network API
findings.remediation: Use HTTPS and keep TLS certificate verification enabled.
findings.impact: Disabling TLS verification or using plaintext HTTP allows MITM interception of all traffic.
findings.attack_vector: rejectUnauthorized: false or http:// URL — attacker can intercept/modify all requests.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.
